name: What types of finishes are available for basement drywall after repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of finishes are available for basement drywall after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: After basement drywall repair, various finishes can be applied to match existing aesthetics or create a new look. Common options include smooth finishes, which offer a sleek, modern appearance, or textured finishes like orange peel, knockdown, or skip trowel, which can help conceal minor imperfections and add character. Priming and painting are typically the final steps to protect the drywall and achieve the desired aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finishes include smooth for a modern look or textured options like orange peel or knockdown to add character or hide imperfections. Priming and painting follow.
